outer_fold_selection.cross_fold_query_reuse: permitted only in non-target roles when it cannot influence the policy evaluated for that query's held-out source

arms.H1: candidate-pooled profile statistics; every candidate receives the same pooled global, class, and subtype vector
arms.H1_5: candidate-specific global profile accuracy/support repeated across semantic slots
arms.H2: candidate-specific global plus class- and subtype-matched profile accuracy/support

policy.gate3_h2_selection: maximize fold-local policy accuracy; tie-break by higher utility, lower serving GPU cost, then fixed margin order
policy.gate4_h2_selection: maximize fold-local policy utility; tie-break by higher accuracy, lower serving GPU cost, then fixed margin order
policy.margin_selection: two independently frozen selectors within each outer fold using only that fold's policy rows

simple_controls.B_A_star_selection: maximize fold-local policy accuracy; tie-break by higher utility, lower serving GPU cost, then fixed method order
simple_controls.B_U_star_selection: maximize fold-local policy utility; tie-break by higher accuracy, lower serving GPU cost, then fixed method order

matched_action_space.cheapest_candidate: five candidates only; retained as a named newcomer-cost reference, not an adaptive matched-space control
matched_action_space.source_conditional_control: forbidden in the confirmatory explicit-source-metadata-blind control set

fixed.H2_action_space: incumbent fallback plus all five frozen candidates
fixed.matched_simple_control_action_space: incumbent plus all five frozen candidates

logistic_raw_training.input_features: semantic primary-class one-hot[7], subtype one-hot[4], ambiguity indicator, eligible-route one-hot[6]
logistic_raw_training.regularization: L2=10.0 on non-intercept coefficients; intercept unpenalized
logistic_raw_training.solver: deterministic full-batch Newton/IRLS with direct linear solve
logistic_raw_training.labels: binary route correctness on fold-local calibration rows

nearest_profile_training.representation: global accuracy, active primary-class accuracy, active subtype accuracy with class fallback
nearest_profile_training.tie_break: lower distance, lower profile generation GPU-seconds, fixed action-space order
nearest_profile_training.incumbent_representation: same smoothing and profile construction as candidates

primary_endpoint.name: Delta_A_C
primary_endpoint.comparator: fold-specific accuracy-selected B_A* without held-out-source data
primary_endpoint.statistical_superiority: two-sided 95% source-stratified paired-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0
primary_endpoint.failure_rule: report not decision-actionable; do not substitute a secondary endpoint

gate4_utility_endpoint.name: Delta_U_C
gate4_utility_endpoint.comparator: fold-specific utility-selected B_U* without held-out-source data

inference.multiplicity: one primary endpoint; other intervals descriptive

cost.C_onboard: C_profile + C_calibration + C_policy + C_training + non-target feature generation required by the method
cost.primary_cache_assumption: conservative first-use cost; every evaluated target query incurs semantic inference for methods that require semantic features
cost.repeated_identical_query_cache: may be reported only as a separately labelled deployment scenario; not used in confirmatory utility

inference_failure_policy.semantic_invalid_output: repeat the identical frozen request up to three total attempts; if still invalid use the frozen general_visual_reasoning/none/ambiguity=true fallback and retain all attempted GPU time
inference_failure_policy.semantic_timeout_or_oom: same deterministic attempt budget; terminal failure uses the same frozen fallback, records the error, and retains attempted GPU time
inference_failure_policy.candidate_empty_timeout_oom_or_exception: three identical deterministic attempts; if all fail, emit an empty sealed response, success=false, retain attempted GPU time, and score incorrect

semantic_timing_freeze.hardware: exactly four visible NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 GPUs
semantic_timing_freeze.warmup: one fixed outcome-free synthetic warm-up before timed rows
semantic_timing_freeze.timing: CUDA-synchronized generation wall time across all four occupied devices
semantic_timing_freeze.GPU_seconds: 4 multiplied by synchronized generation wall seconds
semantic_timing_freeze.denominator: all attempted target queries including terminal failures
semantic_timing_freeze.terminal_failure_cost: measured attempted GPU time retained; failure scores incorrect

authoritative_order: live-verify release and create authorization lock
run fold-local non-target semantic and candidate inference
fit routers and select Gate-3 H2_A, Gate-4 H2_U, B_A*, and B_U*
freeze all five fold policies as one hash-bound bundle
freeze the single all-fold target-route ledger
run only route-required target candidate inference and seal outputs
run Gate-3 primary accuracy analysis and bootstrap
only then run exploratory or oracle analyses
